name: MMCode
description: Programming often involves converting detailed and complex specifications into code, a process during which developers typically utilize visual aids to more effectively convey concepts. While recent developments in Large Multimodal Models have demonstrated remarkable abilities in visual reasoning and mathematical tasks, there is little work on investigating whether these models can effectively interpret visual elements for code generation. To this end, we present MMCode, the first multi-modal coding dataset for evaluating algorithmic problem-solving skills in visually rich contexts.
reputation: A niche but notable benchmark for multimodal code generation, mainly used in research on visually grounded programming rather than broad community leaderboards.
notes: Likely small and specialized, with limited public leaderboard activity; results may be sensitive to prompt format and code execution setup.
